title: 3D Cavitation in Singapore
description: Our 3D Cavitation technology targets stubborn fat cells, helping you achieve a more contoured and toned physique. Book an appointment today!

blocks.html: Uses ultrasound cavitation technology to disrupt fat cells body sculpting.

Ultrasound Cavitation is the use of low frequency ultrasound technology to break down fat cells below the skin. It is a non-surgical method of reducing cellulite and localized fat, helping to contour the body.

blocks.alt: Hardware cosmetology. Body care. Spa treatment. Ultrasound cavitation body contouring treatment. Woman getting anti-cellulite and anti-fat therapy in beauty salon

blocks.html:
• Ideal for targeting small areas to reduce fat for body contouring and sculpting.
  • Safer alternative to liposuction or surgery
  • No downtime

• The therapist glides the cavitation handpiece over the targeted area, delivering low-frequency ultrasound waves.
  • Ultrasound Cavitation uses a strong wave of low frequency ultrasound to “vibrate” the fat cell walls, causing them to disintegrate into a liquid state, and then naturally metabolized by your body and expelled. The result is natural fat loss.
  • You may experience a warm painless sensation during the treatment.
  • There are some immediate results and will continue to see reduction of fat over a few weeks. (Provided that the clients stick to a balanced healthy diet without overeating).
